Package io.webagent4j.workflow

Interface IWorkflowStep

public sealed interface IWorkflowStep
Structural definition of one ordered step within a Workflow.

This is a closed type: Phase 0.8 does not expose a custom workflow-step extension point. Every instance is created through WorkflowSteps, and the interface is sealed so no other implementation can exist anywhere - the compiler rejects one at the point it would be declared, and the JVM's PermittedSubclasses check rejects one that somehow reached the classpath as compiled bytecode. That closure is what lets WorkflowEngine safely treat every step it receives from a Workflow definition as one it knows how to run, without a runtime type check that could otherwise fail for a caller-supplied implementation.
